label: Figure 17.2: An expansionary monetary policy
alt: AD shifts right from AD1 to AD2 along an upward-sloping SRAS. The price level rises from P1 to P2 and real output from Y1 to Y2.
caption: Expansionary monetary policy (lower interest rates or a larger money supply) shifts AD right from AD<sub>1</sub> to AD<sub>2</sub>. Real output rises from Y<sub>1</sub> to Y<sub>2</sub> (higher income and growth, probably lower unemployment) at the cost of a higher price level, P<sub>1</sub> to P<sub>2</sub>.
